card.name: The m in mL after an open parenthesis
card.fires_on: The letter m that begins mL when it follows an opening parenthesis in a table column heading, such as "Infusion Rate (mL/hr)" or "Volume (mL)". It also fires on one stray "and" in a list of events.

modes.label: mL in table headings
modes.description: The m of mL right after "(" in a dosing or infusion table header giving a volume or rate unit.

modes.label: Stray "and"
modes.description: A single case of "and" joining event types in a web page listing.
modes.example: Office of the President MIT World -- special events<< and>> lectures

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the m of mL in the unit shown in the header of a dosing table.
